note: First third-party asset in the project, downloaded as a capability probe: proof that CC0 material can be sourced, licensed, imported and rendered without a paid generation service. Three of the six maps kept — colour, roughness and the OpenGL-convention normal, which is the one Godot expects. Ambient occlusion, displacement and the DirectX normal were dropped rather than carried unused. Not art direction: whether 1K brick reads as authentic Gothic limestone at the canonical camera is a human's call, and CANON.md §5 asks for limestone rather than brick.
